test_title: PYST 59: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The professor's __________ lecture was filled with complex concepts.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Lucid**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"lucid"** means clear and easy to understand; expressing ideas in a way that is easy to comprehend. (स्पष्ट और आसानी से समझ में आने वाला) • **Example:** The teacher gave a lucid explanation of the complex theory, making it easy for everyone to understand.In the sentence, “The professor's __________ lecture was filled with complex concepts,” the word **"lucid"** correctly fits because it contrasts with the idea of complexity — making complex ideas understandable. (स्पष्ट व्याख्यान जो कठिन अवधारणाओं को सरल बना दे) • **Hence, the correct word is: "lucid" (स्पष्ट).** Therefore, the correct answer is: **Lucid**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Lucyd** (कोई अर्थ नहीं): This is a misspelling and is not a valid English word. • **Example:** ✘ Not applicable — not a correct word. • **Lucide** (गलत वर्तनी): This is also a misspelled form and not used in standard English. • **Example:** ✘ Not applicable — incorrect spelling of "lucid". • **Lucied** (गलत वर्तनी): Another incorrect and non-existent form in English. • **Example:** ✘ Not applicable — no dictionary entry or usage. 45:Tc7f, The correct answer is: **Option 1 (in cahoots)**.
